title: pdp_bqt
description: `pdp_bqt` is a temporal biquad filter that supports low-pass, high-pass, all-pass, band-stop, one-pole, and double one-pole filter types. It is somewhat awkward to use directly, so the help patch recommends the `pdp_motion_blur` and `pdp_motion_phase` abstractions; frequency and Q values outside sensible ranges can produce unstable behavior.
